title: QSM-FAI TENURE Record Entry Schema
description: A timestamped, append-only audit log entry attached to an entity or action. Every agent output MUST produce at least one TENURE entry. Conforms to TSS Record rules (TSS-REC-01..05). Defined by QSM-FAI v1.1.0 §6. v1.1: entry_type is now extensible (TEN-06) and an optional escalation_reason field was added for entry_type: escalation (§4.2).

fc_id.description: FiduciaryContext.id this entry is bound to (FC-05).

entry_type.description: MAY be extended with implementation-specific values per TEN-06, provided the extension is declared in the implementation's conformance manifest.

escalation_reason.description: Added v1.1.0. Present only when entry_type is 'escalation'. One of the Escalation Taxonomy values in QSM-FAI §4.2, or an implementation-declared extension (ESC-04) — implementations using an extension SHOULD relax this enum accordingly.

rationale_ref.description: Inline rationale object or a reference id.
